sources.snippet: A from-scratch implementation and comparison of state-of-the-art (SOTA) Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures on the problem of identifying diseases on Cassava leaves. My goal with this project is to implement these top-performing architectures from scratch to classify the disease/condition of cassava plants, and to learn why these architectures were able to achieve SOTA. sources.title: MingDanng/Cassava_Leaf_Disease_AI - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project implements an end-to-end Deep Learning pipeline to classify 5 types of cassava leaf diseases, assisting in automated disease diagnosis for agriculture. The system leverages Transfer Learning with the EfficientNetB3 architecture to achieve high performance on an imbalanced dataset.
